Evan — thanks for the heads-up and the plan. Quick answers below and attaching our working manifest + checklist.

- Sample crate manifest: attached (sample_crate_manifest_v1.xlsx). That includes two large crates for demo counters (120 lbs each), one pallet of collateral (approx 450 lbs total), and an AV case with the LED backdrop (75 lbs). Please confirm pallet slot and forklift availability for arrival window.
- Backdrop: design intent is 9 ft finished height. We can reduce to 8 ft if necessary but prefer 9 ft for sightline over neighboring inline booths. If show rules hard-limit to 8 ft for islands adjacent to halls 10-12, we can do a 2" raised base instead — want to avoid blocking the adjacent demo hub sightline.
- Power / devices: we plan 3 badge scanners (two for entry, one spare), 3 iPads (demo), 1 demo laptop rack, and the backdrop LED driver. Power draw estimate ~6.5A continuous; spike up to ~12A during boot. Ethernet: 2 static IPs requested (one for the laptop, one for badge scanners).

Attached checklist includes: floor decals, lead box, counter weights, spare HDMI cables, and contact details for on-site lead (Marissa). Please confirm freight window (we can accept Wed 06/05 08:00–12:00 or Thu 06/06 14:00–18:00).

Marissa or Logan — can you confirm signage dielines to send to FastPrints? FastPrints turnaround is usually 5 business days but we need final dielines by 05/07 to hit the June ship.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Marissa,

We can produce the backdrop and six vinyl banners within 5 business days once we have final dielines and color profiles. Notes:
- Max print height we can accommodate in a single panel without seam is 126 inches (3.2m). A 9 ft finish is borderline — recommend 108–120 inches to avoid seam lines.
- If you reduce to 8 ft (96 in) you'll be well within tolerance and avoid a visible seam.
- For LED-friendly substrates, provide final art at 150 dpi at full size and include a 3/8" bleed.

Supply ETA if we receive dielines by 2029-05-07: ship on 2029-05-15 via two-day freight. If you need earlier, we can do a rush for an extra fee but would need sign-off by Friday 05/03.

Dielines accepted as: AI, PDF (vector), EPS. We received a partial dieline earlier (backdrop_dielines_v3.ai) but need the final safe/trim layers and a color-approved PDF.

Best,
